messages:
amanda_cs: Hey all — kicking off onboarding for Origami (Greenlane). Quick context: enterprise pilot, will run Redwood Private in their AWS account; goal is a 30-day live trial with 95th p95 latency < 200ms on our test corpus. Need stakeholder roster, clear success criteria, and any obvious renewal risks up front. I can host weekly 30m syncs. Please drop owners + blocker notes.
olivia_cs_mgr: Thanks Amanda — I'm owning overall CS. I'll coordinate weekly cadence. Initial stakeholder list: Sarah (Greenlane PM), Raj (Infra lead), Lila (Security). I'll DM details and add to doc. :thumbsup:
ben_pm: Adding product side — Ben here. Requirements from our side: model version pinning, audit logs access, and SSO. Proposed timeline: week 0-1 infra + creds, week 2 integration/validation, week 3 performance tuning, week 4 pilot demos + go/no-go. Can we confirm infra owner at Greenlane? Also +1 on weekly 30m.
devon_se: Hi — I'm the SE on this. For infra checklist I need:
- VPC peering info or transit gateway details
- IAM roles for example workload: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOnboard
- S3 bucket for prompt/asset exchange
If Greenlane can share network diagram that helps. Also any compliance docs (SOC2/ISO) they require.
marta_onboarding: I'll run enablement + training. Proposed enablement plan:
- Day 1: Quickwalk + creds handoff (30m)
- Day 3: End-to-end demo + self-serve runbook
- Week 2: Hands-on tuning session (1h)
- Ongoing: office hours twice weekly until go-live
I can prepare a checklist and a short playbook to hand to Raj.
amanda_cs: Great — can each of you add your top 2 success criteria here? I'll consolidate into the kickoff doc.
olivia_cs_mgr: Success criteria (CS): 1) 30-day adoption: 5 internal teams using Redwood endpoints for ML feature; 2) No P1 incidents for 30 days post-go-live.
ben_pm: Product success: 1) Latency and throughput meet our SLOs on the integration test harness; 2) Model correctness: top-level quality metric (F1/minimal drift) within 5% of baseline.
devon_se: SE success: 1) End-to-end inference with KV-cache preserved across restarts; 2) SSO + audit logs validated.
marta_onboarding: Enablement success: 1) Two internal champions trained and running the runbook; 2) Zero critical errors during the demo run.
amanda_cs: Renewal risk flags: any contractual or data concerns that could block renewal down the line? Call out early.
olivia_cs_mgr: Known risk: Greenlane legal asked about data residency for embeddings — we should confirm whether they want embeddings restricted to region. Also they may want a longer SLA in contract.
ben_pm: Technical risk: they run a high token-volume batch use-case; need to validate cost run-rate — if cost is high they'll consider a different model profile.
devon_se: Operational risk: limited access windows in their infra team (Raj is only available Tue/Thu mornings) — schedule accordingly.
marta_onboarding: Training risk: user availability for hands-on sessions is thin— recommend recording the tuning session and providing a short self-paced lab.
amanda_cs: Logging the action items I heard:
- Olivia: finalize stakeholder roster + legal questions
- Ben: run cost projection for high-volume batch
- Devon: prepare infra checklist + network diag request
- Marta: draft enablement playbook + recording plan
I'll push to the project board by EOD and send calendar invites for the weekly sync. Any objections?
ben_pm: No objections. +1 on EOD update.
olivia_cs_mgr: Good. I'll ping Sarah & Raj now and loop legal.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Origami Onboard Weekly — starts 2025-07-14T16:00:00Z, recurring weekly 30m. Invite sent to participants.
amanda_cs: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll add a short test prompt set to the shared drive so we can start baseline runs. If anyone wants to add a metric to the baseline (latency/throughput/quality), drop it here.
marta_onboarding: I'll add training metrics: #champions trained, number of runbook runs, time-to-first-successful-call.
devon_se: Adding: cold-start latency, 95th percentile token latency, and failed call rate.
amanda_cs: Perfect. Closing thread — will post the board link shortly. :rocket!
